summary: Mistral released a patch version of the mistral-common library fixing a bug in multi-image content ordering.

practices.reason: A bugfix to multi-image input ordering in a client library could affect teams using multi-image prompts and should be picked up in a routine dependency update.
practices.quote: Fix multi-image content ordering by @juliendenize in https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-common/pull/254
